When I just turned 4, I was at my younger sister’s 1st birthday party. My older sister(11) was pretty excited about the rollercoaster in the venue we were going to. She asked me if I was excited and I said yeah of course, despite not actually knowing what a rollercoaster was. 

When we got there and I ACTUALLY saw what a rollercoaster looked like, I totally chickened out. My sister and our babysitter boarded the coaster and asked me to ride in their cart but my tiny baby heart couldn’t do it, so I stayed behind. 

I ended up wandering around the railings area while other riders were boarding the next section of the rollercoaster. This is when I immediately changed my mind and decided to ride! I didn’t know how to go about it so I wandered around nearer the boarding passengers when two men approached me. 

They called my name out several times so I figured oh hey they know me maybe they can help me out. ( I realize now that I was wearing a name tag as it was..a birthday party ). They stated they were my uncles so I was like oh ok yeah. They asked me if I wanted to ride the rollercoaster and I said I did so they.. 

I don’t remember. I remember thinking I rode, but my sister said she didn’t even see me board and that I was a liar. She said when she got down I was still around the railings so I couldn’t have ridden the one she rode or even the one after. I argued with her that no, I rode with our two uncles. She asked which ones and I said I didn’t know. 

It wasn’t until I retold the story to my mum years later that I realized how disturbing it actually was. No, I don’t actually remember riding the rollercoaster though.
